FAQ

Common questions

Do I need an account to try Sorikano?

No. Open the demo and choose Load complete $60 example to explore a sample invoice and purchase order.

What does a workspace give me?

With an account, you can sign in to a private workspace, upload invoices and purchase orders, and save your review decisions.

Does Sorikano send emails or make payments?

Sorikano can draft a supplier correction request for you to review and send yourself. It does not move money.

Can you find the $60 difference?

Open the demo and load the sample to trace the discrepancy.
